title: Building a Full Personal Website with Vibe Coding and Claude Code
author: 68fbf31ed8a1b5be9abe8aa6
excerpt: Discover how vibe coding with Claude Code can transform the way you build websites. Learn how AI-assisted development enables you to create a complete personal portfolio in hours, not weeks.

children.text: The landscape of web development has fundamentally changed. Gone are the days of spending weeks setting up boilerplate code, wrestling with configuration files, and debugging obscure errors. Welcome to the era of
vibe coding
– where you describe what you want to build, and AI brings it to life.

Vibe coding is a development philosophy where you work at the level of intent rather than implementation details. Instead of typing out every line of code, you communicate your vision to an AI assistant like Claude Code, which then generates production-ready code that matches your mental model.

content.content: 💡 Think of vibe coding as having a senior developer pair programmer who instantly understands your vision and can implement it while you focus on architecture and user experience.

children.text: Claude Code isn't just another code completion tool. It's an AI pair programmer that:
🧠 Understands entire codebases and maintains context across files
✨ Writes complete features from natural language descriptions
🔄 Refactors code while preserving functionality
🐛 Debugs issues by analyzing error messages and logs
📚 Follows best practices and modern frameworks automatically

content.text: Building Your Personal Website: A Real Example

children.text: Let me share how I built a complete personal portfolio website using Claude Code. The entire process took just a few hours, but the result is a production-ready site with modern technologies.

content.content: 🎯 Prompt: 'Set up a Next.js 15 project with TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and a modern portfolio layout with a navigation bar, hero section, projects showcase, and contact form.'

children.text: Within minutes, Claude Code had:
✅ Created the entire project structure
✅ Configured TypeScript and TailwindCSS
✅ Built responsive components
✅ Set up routing and layouts
✅ Added dark mode support
